policy: accepted_source_count and each record's accepted flag describe retained local artifacts only. bg-mfa-visa-ordinance-consolidated.scope: Government-published consolidated text of Ordinance №198/2011 on conditions and procedure for visa issuance and determination of the visa regime.
bg-mfa-visa-ordinance-consolidated.reviewed_content: The document heading identifies the ordinance and its amendment history through issue 4/2025. The reviewed provisions include Article 20(2)(4), which exempts qualifying EU/EEA/Swiss family or household members from the listed insurance-document requirement, and Article 23(3), which grants those family or household members direct access to the consular section without a prior appointment. The MFA parent index lists the ordinance and links to this PDF. The text is read together with the specific later amendments in Decree №221/2025 §3.
limitations: Bulgarian text only; the Bulgarian text is the controlling reference.

The consolidated edition predates Decree №221/2025, published 28 October 2025. Supplement it with §3 of that decree: Article 27(1) wording changed under §3(3); the currency-related changes in Articles 16(3) and 17(1) became effective with euro adoption on 1 January 2026.
The linked MVR-hosted edition that ends in 2019 is stale and is retained only as a historical comparator.
PDF annexes were not visually reviewed and are not relied upon by this reference entry.
This approval is for reference use only and grants no permission to copy or republish the PDF.
This reference does not establish coverage of all consular practice, forms, or other visa and residence law.

bg-visa-amendment-221-2025.publisher: State Gazette of the Republic of Bulgaria
bg-visa-amendment-221-2025.version_or_cutoff: Decree №221 dated 24 October 2025, published in State Gazette issue 90 on 28 October 2025; §3 addresses Ordinance №198/2011.
bg-visa-amendment-221-2025.scope: Targeted later amendment to the consolidated Visa Ordinance: changes in §3(1)-(2) to Articles 16(3) and 17(1), and in §3(3) to Article 27(1).
bg-visa-amendment-221-2025.reviewed_content: The Gazette text removes wording referring to payment in levs from Articles 16(3) and 17(1), and deletes the phrase limiting Article 27(1) to validity of up to one year. §4 makes §3(1)-(2) effective on the date of euro introduction; the European Commission confirms that date was 1 January 2026. §4 gives no separate later date for §3(3); applying Constitution Article 5(5) default commencement three days after promulgation yields 31 October 2025.
limitations: This is an amending act, not a consolidated version of the whole ordinance.
The 31 October 2025 commencement date for §3(3) is derived from the constitutional default because §4 names no separate date; this is a source-based interpretation, not a date printed in the decree.
No copying or republication permission is inferred from reference use.
